# Search

**Package** `episteme.search.v1`

## Services

### `Search`

Retrieves points by vector similarity.

| Method | Request | Response | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SearchCollection` | `SearchCollectionRequest` | `SearchCollectionResponse` | Searches a collection for the nearest points to a query vector. |
| `BatchSearchCollection` | `BatchSearchCollectionRequest` | `BatchSearchCollectionResponse` | Runs several searches against one collection in a single request. |

## Messages

### `SearchStats`

Why a query cost what it did.  Returned so a slow or surprising result can be explained without reproducing it under a profiler.

| Field | Type | # | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `candidates_visited` | `int64` | 1 |  | Vectors actually scored. Latency tracks this far more closely than it tracks the requested result count. |
| `reranked_count` | `int64` | 2 |  | Candidates that were rescored at full precision after a coarse scan. |
| `buffer_hit_count` | `int32` | 3 |  | Results drawn from the unsealed write buffer. The buffer is scanned exhaustively, so these are exact. They are reported separately because counting them alongside index results would inflate any recall measurement. |
| `index_hit_count` | `int32` | 4 |  | Results drawn from a sealed segment through its index. |
| `filter_strategy` | `string` | 5 |  | Filter strategy the planner chose, such as `prefilter` or `traversal`. |

### `SearchResult`

One result of a search.

| Field | Type | # | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `point` | `string` | 1 |  | Resource name of the matching point. |
| `score` | `float` | 2 |  | Similarity or distance, on the scale of the field's own metric. Whether a higher value is nearer depends on that metric. |
| `span` | `episteme.shared.v1.Span` | 3 |  | Interval of the source media this result covers, for time-indexed content. |
| `content_ref` | `episteme.shared.v1.ContentRef` | 4 |  | Reference to the bytes this result was derived from. |
| `vector` | `episteme.shared.v1.Vector` | 5 |  | The raw vector, when it was requested and permitted. |

### `SearchCollectionRequest`

Request message for searching a collection.

| Field | Type | # | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `collection` | `string` | 1 |  | Collection to search. |
| `field` | `string` | 2 | `REQUIRED` | Named vector field to search. Each field has its own model and metric, so a query is meaningful only against the field it was encoded for. |
| `query` | `episteme.shared.v1.Vector` | 3 | `REQUIRED` | The query vector. |
| `result_count` | `int32` | 4 | `REQUIRED` | Maximum number of results to return. |
| `candidate_breadth` | `int32` | 5 | `OPTIONAL` | Candidate breadth during the search. Larger values improve recall and cost latency on every request. Zero selects a server-chosen default. |
| `include_vectors` | `bool` | 6 | `OPTIONAL` | Whether to include raw vectors in the results. Separate from searching because a vector can be inverted toward its source text, so permission to search is not permission to export. |

### `SearchCollectionResponse`

Response message for searching a collection.

| Field | Type | # | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `results` | `repeated SearchResult` | 1 |  | Matching points, nearest first. |
| `complete` | `bool` | 2 |  | Whether every source answered. False when a shard missed its deadline or a vault was locked. Present from the first release because a caller must be able to distinguish "no results" from "no results you are currently able to see", and adding it later would break the most-used message in the API. |
| `answered_source_count` | `int32` | 3 |  | Sources that answered within the deadline. |
| `total_source_count` | `int32` | 4 |  | Sources that were consulted. |
| `locked_vaults` | `repeated string` | 5 |  | Vaults skipped because they are locked. Names only, never contents. |
| `stats` | `SearchStats` | 6 |  | What the planner did, for explain and for tuning. |
